name: omarchy-plugin-publish
description: Publish Omarchy plugins: audits against marketplace rules and observed reviewer blockers, checks publishing readiness, and prepares the submission issue.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare Omarchy plugins for marketplace validation and review
interface.longDescription: Audits an Omarchy plugin against the marketplace's machine-enforced rules and the blockers maintainers actually raise, runs an offline publishing-readiness check, fixes what you authorize, and assembles a submission tied to one exact commit. It does not approve anything; listing remains a maintainer decision.
defaultPrompt: Is my Omarchy plugin ready to publish?
Audit this plugin for the Omarchy marketplace security review.
